fact: The policy says Data.gov.ng has been developed as the national catalogue of open data, requires agencies to link their datasets to it and to post a Rolling Release Schedule on it; the document does not name who runs the portal, and ties it to the policy; it names no publishing ministry and gives no dataset count (document published 2018-07).

Anambra State Government launched a redesigned official website at anambrastate.gov.ng whose Open Government section gives access to budgets, audit reports, procurement plans, contract awards and open data; no dataset count is given and the document's date, 2026-10-01, is used as the launch date.

The Federal Ministry of Education launched the Public DNEMIS Portal on 1 July 2026, which the ministry says gives researchers, journalists, civil society and the public access to selected official education data through an interactive online platform; no download or dataset count is stated.
